summary: Layer 1B expands the node around regulated student-loan servicing, private education-loan operations, education accounts-receivable payments, borrower communications, and government/BPO servicing workflows. The cleanest direct public-market reference is Nelnet because it explicitly reports Loan Servicing and Systems plus Education Technology Services and Payments. The underfollowed lane adds Flywire as a vertical education-payments and student-financial-software platform, Maximus as a government-service/BPO operator with Federal Student Aid borrower-support exposure, and Navient as a small-cap speculative shadow asset whose education-loan exposure is large but increasingly credit-book/outsourced-servicing rather than pure platform quality.
